title: 第1379章 半帝之威第1378章 往日旧事
content_zh:
“你们这些脏东西，还有臭水沟里的阴暗老鼠，敢动人族圣王一根毫毛，那今日都别想走了。”
话音响起的瞬间。
整个天地，乃至是小域外战场的天穹上空都笼罩着一层层的浓郁的帝威，雷霆翻涌，七彩祥云相映，整个天幽州大陆的法则本源似乎都是在欢呼雀跃。
仿佛在恭迎着它的主人到来一般。
“这股威压。。。”赤骇我瞳孔猛然一震，神色忽然变得凝重。
无面天王脸上并无五官，则看不到丝毫的表情变化，但是从他握着茶杯的手微微颤抖的细微动作来看，显然是有些不自然。
“帝川，本天王就说，你怎会眼睁睁的看着人族圣王而置之不理，原来早就猜到了她会出现，对吧？”
后者微微一笑，摊开手道：
“没办法，谁让我一人不是你和赤骸的对手呢，那就只能请帮手过来了。”
“但，这一位，可不是我能请得动的。”
“哼！！！”无面自然也是清楚，只能重重的冷哼一声。
这一位，他们可是一直在关注着，听闻早在很久之前便对外宣布闭关冲击下一境，在帝宫的地位程度，在某个方面的时候甚至是比帝君还要高。
“不是说任何人不得打扰她么？她怎么会出关？”无面呢喃着。
帝川嘴角微微掀起一抹弧度，无面这些外人可能不知道，但他还是能知晓几分的。
这一切，恐怕是跟道宫离不开几分关系。
轰隆！
金光普照，七彩圣梯缓缓出现在天穹之上。
而后，只见一个身穿华丽玄红色的贵妇缓缓一步步踏着天梯走出。
身穿裙尾摇曳生姿，每踏出一步，在她身上的帝威便自然得加重了几分，丹凤眼，金瞳孔，举手投足间，无不散发着上位者的威严气息。
见状。

太华等在场的所有圣王境强者，哪怕是帝川这位帝尊都是瞬间站起身来，恭敬的弯腰作揖，齐声道：
“拜见长公主殿下！”
“帝川，见过长公主殿下。”
后者微微颔首：“无需多礼，都起来吧。”
此刻，她一双美眸居高临下的盯着齐长风，眉目深处涌现出一抹莫名的柔和，红唇轻启道：
“你便是李太玄的大弟子，齐长风吧？”
齐长风抬眸，点点头抱拳作揖道；
“是，晚辈见过长公主殿下。”
“好好好。”
“数千载过去了，当年那个只会跟随在李太玄屁股后面的小小尊者，如今竟也是成就圣王了。”
说话间，一股柔和的力量将齐长风托举起来。
这一细微的动作让赤骸神色微微一变，心中掀起一丝波澜。
据他所知，人族的长公主殿下那可是对外人冷漠至极，哪怕是对他们这些帝宫圣王境都没有这等待遇。
这齐长风身份到底有何特殊？
帝川和太华等人见状都是心照不宣。
齐长风这才是仔细打量起眼前的长公主，风华绝代，英姿飒爽，实力可以说是站在了大陆女人的顶点。
年轻的时候，有幸跟随在师尊身边远远的见过一面。
心中暗暗自语：“这便是差点成为了我师娘的长公主殿下么？”
“师尊这老头子配长公主可真的是高攀了，真不知道老头子那家伙是怎么想的。”
content_en:
"You dirty things, and the dark rats in the stinking ditch, if you dare to touch a hair of the Holy King of the Human Race, then don't even think about leaving today."
The moment the voice sounded.
The entire heaven and earth, and even the sky above the battlefield outside the small domain, are covered with layers of rich imperial power. Thunder surges, colorful auspicious clouds reflect each other, and the origin of the laws of the entire Tianyouzhou continent seems to be cheering for joy.
It seems to be welcoming the arrival of its owner.
"This pressure..." Chi Hai's pupils suddenly trembled, and his expression suddenly became solemn.
There are no facial features on the face of the Faceless King, so no change in expression can be seen at all, but judging from the subtle movements of his hand holding the tea cup, it is obviously a little unnatural.
"Di Chuan, this heavenly king said, how could you just watch the human race's Holy King and ignore her? It turned out that she had already guessed that she would appear, right?"
The latter smiled slightly, spread his hands and said:
"There is no other way. I am not a match for you and Chi Gu, so I can only ask for help."
"But, this person is not someone I can hire."
"Hmph!!!" Wu Mian naturally knew it and could only snort heavily.
They have been paying attention to this person. They heard that he had announced his retreat to the next realm a long time ago. His status in the imperial palace was even higher than that of the emperor in some aspects.
"Didn't you say that no one is allowed to disturb her? How could she get out of seclusion?" Wu Mian murmured.
The corner of Dichuan's mouth curled up slightly. Outsiders like Wu Mian might not know this, but he still knew something about it.
All of this is probably inseparable from the Dao Palace.
Boom!
Golden light shines all over the place, and the colorful holy ladder slowly appears in the sky.
Then, I saw a lady dressed in gorgeous dark red slowly walking up the ladder step by step.
She was swaying in her skirt, and with every step she took, the imperial authority on her body naturally increased. Her red and phoenix eyes, golden pupils, and every move she made exuded the majestic aura of a superior.
See this.
Taihua and all the Saint King Realm experts present, even the Emperor Dichuan, instantly stood up, bowed respectfully, and said in unison:
"Meet Her Royal Highness the Princess!"
"Dichuan, I have met Her Royal Highness the eldest princess."
The latter nodded slightly: "No need to be polite, just get up."
At this moment, her beautiful eyes were staring down at Qi Changfeng, an inexplicable softness emerged from the depths of her brows, her red lips parted lightly and she said:
"You are Li Taixuan's eldest disciple, Qi Changfeng, right?"
Qi Changfeng raised his eyes, nodded and clasped his fists in salute;
"Yes, this junior has met Her Royal Highness the Eldest Princess."
"Okay, okay."
"Thousands of years have passed. The little venerable person who only followed Li Taixuan back then has now become a holy king."
As he spoke, a gentle force lifted Qi Changfeng up.
This subtle movement made Chi Gu's expression change slightly, and caused a wave of excitement in his heart.
As far as he knew, Her Royal Highness, the eldest princess of the human race, was extremely indifferent to outsiders, even those in the Imperial Palace and Saint King realm did not receive such treatment.
What is so special about Qi Changfeng’s identity?
When Dichuan, Taihua and others saw this, they all understood it tacitly.
Only then did Qi Changfeng take a closer look at the eldest princess in front of him. She was unparalleled in elegance, heroic appearance, and her strength could be said to be at the pinnacle of mainland women.
When I was young, I was fortunate enough to follow Master and meet him from a distance.
He secretly said to himself: "Is this the eldest princess who almost became my master's wife?"
"Master, this old man is really high up for marrying the eldest princess. I really don't know what the old man is thinking."
